name: Peasant's Sling
description: A simple, braided sling used by herders and the poorest of militia. Effective only in the most desperate of situations.

name: Bone Shortbow
description: Crafted from the rib of a great beast and strung with its tendons. A primitive but reliable weapon.

name: Ironwood Recurve
description: A finely crafted bow from the heartwood of an ironwood tree, granting it superior power and resilience.

name: Gnome-engineered Hand Crossbow
description: A compact, clockwork crossbow with a magazine for five bolts. Favored by rogues and artisans.

name: Elven Hunting Longbow
description: A bow of elegant and impossible grace, seemingly grown rather than made. Silent and deadly in the right hands.

name: Dwarven Heavy Repeater
description: A massive, crank-operated crossbow that fires heavy bolts at a frightening rate. Requires a strong arm to wield effectively.

name: Titanstring Bow
description: A legendary bow strung with the sinew of a titan. It draws upon the wielder's strength, firing arrows with earth-shattering force.

name: Goblin Toss-Knife
description: A crudely sharpened piece of scrap metal, balanced for throwing. As likely to injure the thrower as the target.

name: Windlass Crossbow
description: A powerful crossbow requiring a windlass to cock. Slow to load, but packs a tremendous punch.

name: Shadow-Woven Shortbow
description: Forged in the Shadowfell, this bow's arrows seem to drink the light around them, making them near-impossible to dodge.

name: Blunderbuss
description: A loud, messy firearm that fires a spray of shrapnel. Devastating at close range but highly inaccurate.

name: Boomerang of Returning
description: A masterfully carved wooden boomerang that magically returns to the thrower's hand, provided it doesn't hit a target.

name: Javelin of Lightning
description: When thrown, this javelin transforms into a line of lightning, striking the first target in its path.

name: Thorn Whip
description: A druidic weapon, a living vine that can strike at a distance and entangle foes.

name: Arquebus
description: An early, long-barreled firearm. Powerful and armor-piercing, but prone to misfires and requires a forked stand to aim.

name: Sunstone Sling
description: A sling of gilded leather that fires sunstone pellets. Its projectiles glow with radiant energy, harmful to the undead.

name: Orcish Skull-Launcher
description: A brutal contraption that hurls spiked skulls or similarly sized rocks. More terrifying than accurate.

name: Wyvern-Fang Blowgun
description: A blowgun crafted from a hollowed wyvern fang. Often used to deliver potent toxins.

name: Hooked Net
description: A weighted net used to entangle and trip opponents, rather than cause direct injury.

name: Crystal Shard Launcher
description: An arcane focus that fires concentrated shards of pure force.

name: Ballista Bolt (Siege)
description: A massive bolt meant for a ballista. Not a wieldable weapon, but a munition for siege engines.

name: Fey-Twisted Branch
description: A branch from the Feywild that never runs out of magical thorns to fire. Its shots can cause confusion or sleep.

name: Repeating Hand Crossbow
description: A sophisticated hand crossbow with a top-mounted 6-bolt magazine, allowing for rapid fire.

name: Flametongue Longbow
description: Arrows nocked on this bow burst into magical flame, dealing severe fire damage on impact.

name: Gnomish Acid Sprinkler
description: A device that sprays a cone of corrosive acid. Short-ranged and requires careful handling.

name: Drow Poison Needle-Shooter
description: A delicate, wrist-mounted device that silently fires needles coated in paralytic drow poison.

name: Giant's Throwing Boulder
description: A favorite projectile of hill and stone giants. Not a weapon to be carried, but certainly to be avoided.

name: Whisper-Fletched Arrow (Ammo)
description: Special arrows that make no sound in flight. They confer their silent property to the bow that fires them.

name: Spectral Longbow
description: A bow formed from the essence of the Ethereal Plane. Its arrows can strike ethereal creatures and phase through minor barriers.

name: Halfling Soup-Can Launcher
description: A quirky slingshot-like weapon built to fire heavy cans or stones with surprising force. A halfling innovation.

name: Mithril-Hafted Javelin
description: A javelin so perfectly balanced and light it can be thrown with pinpoint accuracy over incredible distances.

name: Onyx Panther Shortbow
description: A bow as black as midnight, carved in the likeness of a stalking panther. Grants the wielder enhanced night vision.

name: Arcane Blast-Rod
description: A fundamental wizard's weapon, channeling raw magical energy into a destructive bolt. Scales with the user's power.

name: Serpentine Bow
description: A bow wrapped in the scales of a giant constrictor snake. Arrows fired from it have a chance to poison the target.

name: Gravity Cannon
description: An experimental dwarven cannon that uses gravitational fields to launch solid metal spheres at hypersonic speeds.

name: Auran Wind-Bow
description: A bow made by air elementals. It creates its own arrows from solidified wind and never needs ammunition.

name: Trebuchet (Siege)
description: The superior siege engine. Hurls massive stones or incendiary payloads over castle walls. A stationary weapon.

name: Chakram
description: A sharp, circular throwing blade. Skilled users can make it ricochet off surfaces.

name: Dragonbone Greatbow
description: A bow of immense power, crafted from the bones and sinew of an ancient dragon. Imbues arrows with elemental energy.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: A classic arcane focus that projects unerring bolts of force. Damage is consistent but not overwhelming.

name: Barbed Sling Bullet (Ammo)
description: Lead bullets with cruel barbs designed to cause bleeding wounds and be difficult to remove.

name: Starfall Longbow
description: Forged from a meteorite, this bow fires arrows that gleam like falling stars, dealing radiant damage and blinding foes.

name: Gnomish Shocker
description: A handheld device that launches a pair of conductive darts connected by a wire, delivering a powerful electric shock.

name: Molotov Cocktail
description: An improvised incendiary weapon. The initial impact is less dangerous than the spreading fire that follows.

name: Harp of Sonic Shards
description: A bardic instrument that, when played, fires projectiles of solidified sound.

name: Phase-Lock Crossbow
description: This crossbow's bolts ignore conventional armor, phasing through it to strike the target's true form beneath.

name: Shrieker Dart
description: A dart with a specially designed head that emits a piercing shriek in flight, disorienting the target.

name: Living Longbow
description: A bow that is a symbiotic creature. It can adjust its draw weight and even guide arrows slightly towards their target.

name: Explosive Bolt (Ammo)
description: A crossbow bolt with an alchemical charge in its head. Explodes on impact, dealing area damage.

name: Griffon Rider's Lance
description: A long, aerodynamic lance designed to be dropped from a great height onto targets below.

name: Blightwood Blowgun
description: A blowgun carved from wood corrupted by necrotic energy. Its darts inflict a rotting disease.

name: Orcish Throw-Axe
description: A heavy, unbalanced axe designed for one thing: being hurled with overwhelming force at an enemy's face.

name: Crystal Spire Longbow
description: A bow of breathtaking beauty, carved from a single giant crystal. It focuses sunlight into devastating laser-like arrows.

name: Netherium Repeater
description: A weapon from the lower planes, this crossbow fires bolts that siphon the life force of those they strike.

name: Bola
description: Weights connected by cords, thrown to entangle an enemy's legs and bring them to the ground.

name: Gravity Hammer
description: A massive hammer that, when thrown, creates a localized gravity well upon impact, crushing armor and bone.

name: Wasp-Nest-on-a-Stick
description: The lowest form of ranged weaponry. Throw it and run. The damage comes from the ensuing swarm of angry insects.

name: Spectral Dagger
description: A dagger that can be magically summoned back to the hand after being thrown. A favorite of spellblades.

name: Flame-Belcher
description: A primitive, dragon-like flamethrower that spews a cone of burning alchemical gel.

name: Heartseeker Bow
description: A bow that guides its arrows unerringly to the most vulnerable spot on a target, often bypassing armor entirely.

name: Anchor Hook Launcher
description: Fires a grappling hook on a chain. Can be used to pull objects, enemies, or for cinematic swinging.

name: Thunderstone
description: A alchemically-treated stone that creates a deafening thunderclap when it strikes a hard surface.

name: Void-Touched Shortbow
description: A bow that seems to absorb light and sound. Its arrows create small voids upon impact, dealing force and necrotic damage.

name: Gnomish Pocket Catapult
description: A folding, spring-loaded mini-catapult perfect for launching caltrops, alchemical pellets, or small rocks.

name: Quill of the Storyteller
description: A mythical artifact. It does not deal physical damage, but can 'write' events into reality, making it the most potent ranged weapon of all.
